headline: Oil Prices Plunge Amid U.S. Elections and Middle East De-Escalation Hopes
summary: WTI crude oil headed for sharp weekly losses as prices shed over 11%, while Asia's fuel oil refining margins slumped on U.S. midterm outcomes boosting hopes for Middle East de-escalation.
why: Crude oil is a vital global energy commodity influencing transport costs, inflation metrics, and energy sector equities worldwide.

impacts.name: WTI Crude
impacts.why: The input states December WTI crude oil shed $11.37, or 11.10%.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Oil prices plunged following U.S. election outcomes that boosted hopes for de-escalation in the Middle East and allowed more oil products to move out of the region.
